title: Grateful Dead Live at Easttown Theatre on 1971-10-23

ai_review.summary: Very poor sound quality – playback is too fast and muffled – while the setlist itself is decent but unverified musically.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers flag serious audio problems, describing the tape as running far too fast and sounding like a low‑fidelity FM broadcast. No specific musical strengths or weaknesses are mentioned beyond noting that the setlist is nice; one reviewer even points to an alternate CM version with far better sound. In short, the recording is essentially unlistenable for most fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently low star ratings (0‑2) and unanimous criticism of audio quality drive the rating down; there is no positive commentary on performance to offset the technical flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Playback runs too fast, appears dragged or pulled from a radio/FM source, resulting in muffled and unbalanced sound; listeners recommend seeking an alternate CM version.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist described as nice but no details on flow or pacing are given.
